title: Lemon Garlic Salmon with Green Beans
description: Buttery garlic salmon and crisp-tender green beans roasted together in under 30 minutes.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss the green beans with the oil and a pinch each of salt and pepper on a sheet pan, then push them to one side.
Pat the salmon dry, season both sides with salt and pepper and lay it skin-side down on the empty side of the pan.
Melt the butter in a small bowl in the microwave. Stir in the garlic and the juice of half the lemon. Spoon it over the salmon and top each fillet with a thin slice from the other half.
Roast until the salmon flakes easily with a fork, 12 to 15 minutes.
Scatter parsley over the top and spoon the pan juices over everything.
